author: Haroen Viaene
subject: feat: server side rendering (algolia/vue-instantsearch#596)
bodyLines: * chore: add initial ssr example (no Algolia)
* chore: redo SSR via vue cli & add algolia page
* fix: call render once on client to give state before render
* chore: set default params to avoid highlight not working
* chore: no linting on ssr example until we are done
* fix: make sure it works with complex components
search parameters is necessary if during mount the widget uses functions on the results
* feat: throw warning when SSR and no injection
* chore(ssr): small logic refactor of name
* test(ssr): write tests for all injection functions
* refactor(SSR): hydrate doesn't assume where serialized state comes from
* feat(ssr): add a warning if __forceRender gets called without active helper
* chore(build): don't do examples of nuxt & ssr
* fix(core): make InstantSearch(Ssr) into regular .js files (algolia/vue-instantsearch#605)
* fix(core): make InstantSearch(Ssr) into regular .js files
The reason I did this is to make sure that rollup turns this into valid components (before the template was compiled into the arguments of `createInstantSearchComponent` instead of into its result.
* chore(test): use a global mock of InstantSearch.js root
* refactor(ssr): better naming for function argument
* refactor(ssr): findResultsState returns nothing, introduce getState
* docs(example-ssr): make use of correct state var
* fix(ssr): move getState error to warning
this is not a fatal warning, so throwing can confuse people
* fix(ssr): prevent overriding of forced parameters
* docs(ssr): add explaining comment on searchOnce
* fix(babel): use _objectSpread from babel instead of Object.assign
* refactor(ais-instant-search): move from pure factory function to augmented factory
This limits the amounts of conditionals in the code
* chore(examples): avoid lint for now (prettier conflicts)
* fix(ssr): only __forceRender once on server, once on client
*  fix(core): prevent instance from starting multiple times (algolia/vue-instantsearch#607)
* fix(core): prevent instance from starting multiple times
This was no problem with regular InstantSearch; but when in SSR the instance is not recreated when InstantSearch mounts; and thus it starts again, which throws an error.
We need to set the flag to false, since otherwise InstantSearch throws an error.
* test(core): dispose gets called and started gets patched
* refactor(ssr): getState shouldn't warn if early
* refactor(cis): createInstantSearch has same signature as regular instantsearch
* fix(destroy): set helper to null to avoid old requests
* fix(core): set hydrated to false on destroy
* fix(ssr): do not allow instance to start multiple times
This can only happen in extreme edge cases (mount - unmount - nextTick - mount).
